summary: Liminatus Pharma filed an 8-K regarding a warrant exercise inducement letter with a holder of existing warrants covering 10,344,000 shares. The holder agreed to immediately exercise those warrants at a reduced cash exercise price of $0.18 per share, generating ~$1.86M gross proceeds. In exchange, the company issued new inducement warrants to purchase up to 20,688,000 shares at $0.18 per share, half with standard Black-Scholes terms and half with change-of-control features. The inducement warrants require stockholder approval before exercisability. Net proceeds will fund working capital. This is a capital-raising inducement transaction with no change of control, acquisition, or restructuring involved.
